# TerrainEmbedding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neural representation that encodes uneven terrain features (e.g., height maps, roughness) into a compact latent space used by the locomotion policy. Bridges perception and control, allowing the neuromorphic system to generalize across diverse terrains without exhaustive retraining.
